body.heading: Where in the world is Moldova?
paragraphs: Moldova is a country in Eastern Europe, which is part of Europe.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Moldova is Chișinău.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: The language you will hear most in Moldova is Romanian.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Moldova is the Moldovan leu.

body.heading: How big is Moldova?
paragraphs: Moldova covers about 34,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about half the size of Ireland.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: Old Orhei is a natural amphitheatre of cliffs where a cave monastery was dug into the rock above the Răut River 2,000 years of history in one valley.
Moldova's wine cellars are underground cities — Cricova's tunnels run for 120 kilometres, and Mileștii Mici holds the world's largest wine collection.
